title: Canonical URL points to dead staging domain (masoko.mogen.co.za → 523)
evidence: Homepage <link rel="canonical" href="https://masoko.mogen.co.za"/> and og:url both point to https://masoko.mogen.co.za. Live check: masoko.mogen.co.za returns HTTP 523 (Origin is unreachable) on Cloudflare. The production domain is www.masokopsychology.co.za. NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL defaults to https://masoko.mogen.co.za in app/layout.tsx:27 when env var is unset.
impact: Search engines see staging URL as canonical and will not index the production domain correctly; link equity diluted, risk of de-indexation, OG shares break (404 og:image/logo).
recommendation: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://www.masokopsychology.co.za in Vercel Production env. Fix metadataBase and jsonLd.url/logo/image to use production domain.
expected_benefit: Correct indexation, OG shares work, canonical consolidation.

title: No robots.txt (404)
evidence: GET https://www.masokopsychology.co.za/robots.txt → 404. Next.js App Router has no app/robots.ts. Verified via live fetch 2026-09-15.
impact: No crawl directives, no sitemap reference. Wastes crawl budget, AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot) undeclared.
recommendation: Add app/robots.ts with allow-all + sitemap reference. Add llms.txt for AI visibility.

title: No sitemap.xml (404) — site is 100% undeclared to search engines
evidence: GET https://www.masokopsychology.co.za/sitemap.xml → 404. GET /sitemap_index.xml → 404. App Router has no app/sitemap.ts. Verified via live fetch and HTTP headers.
impact: No discovery path for /, /about, /contact, /services/*. Indexation depends purely on external links (which don't exist yet).
recommendation: Add app/sitemap.ts generating entries for /, /about, /contact, /services subpages with lastModified, priority, changeFrequency.

title: OG image + logo.png 404 — social previews broken
evidence: HEAD https://www.masokopsychology.co.za/opengraph-image.png → 404. HEAD /logo.png → 404. jsonLd.image and logo reference https://masoko.mogen.co.za/opengraph-image.png which 523s. Homepage has no <meta property="og:image"/> tag (only og:title/description/url). Twitter card summary_large_image without image URL.
impact: WhatsApp/Facebook/LinkedIn shares render without image, CTR penalty. Google validator flags missing og:image.
recommendation: Create app/opengraph-image.tsx (Next.js OG generator) + public/logo.png and opengraph-image.png, fix jsonLd to reference production URLs.
expected_benefit: Rich previews, 15-30% higher CTR on social shares.

title: Meta keywords polluted with 42 irrelevant MOGEN dev terms
evidence: data/seo.ts BASE_KEYWORDS contains: web development, digital marketing, MOGEN, Pretoria, Mmakau, Ga-Rankuwa... etc (42 terms). Injected into every page via layout.tsx metadata.keywords. Zero terms contain psychologist, therapy, Randburg, Soweto.
impact: Keyword dilution, topical irrelevance, compete for wrong SERPs, zero relevance for 'clinical psychologist randburg/soweto'. Google ignores meta keywords but local scrapers/AI classify site as web dev agency.
recommendation: Replace BASE_KEYWORDS with psychology-intent list (10-15 terms): clinical psychologist randburg, psychologist soweto, couple therapy gauteng, trauma counselling etc. Remove SERVICE_KEYWORDS dev remnants.

title: Duplicate meta descriptions across all pages
evidence: Homepage: 'Professional psychological care for individuals, couples...' About page title changes but meta description identical. Contact page identical. Verified via double fetch 2026-09-15.
impact: SERP cannibalization, pogo-sticking, Google rewrites descriptions, lower CTR for 'about' and 'contact' intents.
recommendation: Write unique 145-155 char descriptions per route: About → credentials/experience; Contact → Randburg & Soweto locations + phone; Services → modalities.

title: Empty alt on hero image + thin alt strategy
evidence: Homepage renders 2 images: first alt='Modern therapy room with natural light' (good), second alt='' empty (decorative duplicate). No images on /about or /contact with descriptive alt. No image sitemap.
impact: Accessibility WCAG 1.1.1 failure on decorative duplication, missed image search opportunity for 'therapy room randburg'.
recommendation: Keep one hero, mark duplicate as aria-hidden, add meaningful alt to therapist portrait (ntokozo-masoko.png exists in /public/images but unused on homepage).

title: No hreflang (acceptable) but locale en_ZA not declared via alternates
evidence: html lang='en' correct, og:locale en_ZA present, but no <link rel='alternate' hreflang='en-ZA'> or x-default. hreflang count 0 verified.
impact: Negligible for single-language ZA site, but missed reinforcement for ZA targeting.
recommendation: Optional: add alternates.languages in layout.tsx.

title: Thin service content + no dedicated service pages for SEO
evidence: Homepage #services lists 7 services as accordion buttons with 1-2 sentence hidden paragraphs. No individual URLs like /services/individual-therapy. All content remains in single homepage JS toggle (opacity:0;height:0px when collapsed) — crawlers see it but no topical depth or internal linking.
impact: Cannot rank for long-tail 'couples therapy randburg' — single page competing for 7 intents. No FAQ schema, no how-it-works content.
recommendation: Create 6 service detail pages under /services/[slug] with 600-900 words, FAQs, process, fees, CTA. Keep accordion as navigation.

title: PostalAddress missing streetAddress — GBP NAP incomplete
evidence: jsonLd.address entries contain only locality, postalCode, region, country. No streetAddress, no geo coordinates. Google Business Profile requires street-level NAP for map pack eligibility.
impact: Cannot win 'psychologist near me' map pack; NAP inconsistency risk if GBP has full street address.
recommendation: Add streetAddress for both Randburg (Ferndale area) and Soweto clinics, add geo {lat,long}, add hasMap URLs, add priceRange.

title: LocalBusiness schema type generic — should be + MedicalBusiness / Physician
evidence: Current @type ProfessionalService. For clinical psychologist, Google prefers MedicalBusiness > Physician or HealthAndBeautyBusiness with medicalSpecialty: Psychology. No HPCSA number, no practitioner Person schema for Ntokozo Masoko.
impact: Lower E-E-A-T signals, not eligible for health-specific rich results, no practitioner knowledge panel.
recommendation: Change to @type ['ProfessionalService','MedicalBusiness'] or add mainEntity Person schema with name, jobTitle: Clinical Psychologist, identifier HPCSA number, alumniOf, memberOf.
expected_benefit: Higher health E-E-A-T, practitioner rich results.

title: No localized landing pages for Randburg vs Soweto
evidence: Single homepage serves 2 locations (Randburg 2064, Soweto 2150) plus areaServed array of 8 suburbs. No /randburg or /soweto pages, no location-specific NAP, openingHours unified. This dilutes 'Randburg psychologist' and 'Soweto psychologist' relevance.
impact: Loses to competitors with dedicated suburb pages; Google cannot associate content to a specific location.
recommendation: Create /locations/randburg and /locations/soweto with NAP, map embed (Leaflet already in deps), directions, FAQs, unique content. Link from footer/contact.
expected_benefit: 2x local relevance, map pack entries per suburb.

title: sameAs + social links point to Mogen agency, not Masoko clinic
evidence: jsonLd.sameAs: twitter.com/MogenPty, x.com/MogenPty, instagram.com/MogenPty, linkedin.com/in/MogenPty — all MOGEN web agency profiles. Zero links to Masoko clinic socials. Footer likely inherits same.
impact: Brand confusion, agency inherits authority instead of clinic, Wikidata/knowledge graph pollution.
recommendation: Replace sameAs with actual Masoko socials or remove until clinic profiles exist. Add Facebook/Instagram for Masoko if available; otherwise keep only site URL.
expected_benefit: Clean entity graph, correct brand authority.

title: Large LCP image served via uncached /_next/image with 1x/2x srcSet doubling weight
evidence: Hero office-chair.png 1024x1024 requested at w=1080 and w=2048 in same srcSet. Served via Vercel Image Optimization but with X-Vercel-Cache HIT and Age 110738 (30h) suggests stale cache max-age=0 must-revalidate. No priority flag observed, no preload for hero. Measured: HTML Content-Length 70985, likely LCP >2.5s on 3G.
impact: LCP penalty, CWV failure risk, bounce on mobile (primary traffic for local searches).
recommendation: Add priority to next/image hero, use sizes='(max-width:1024px) 100vw, 50vw', compress to WebP <150KB, add images remotePatterns cleanup, enable image caching headers.

title: No preconnect for Google Fonts + missing font fallback optimization
evidence: Fonts preloaded via /_next/static/media woff2 (good) but Instrument_Serif + Inter loaded with display:swap. No preconnect needed for self-hosted, but overall JS includes 9 chunks (2xys, 3zep, 3kee, 3wud, turpopack, 0dqc, 1zj7, 1cq7, 2g0q etc.) — total JS ~unknown but Turbopack dev build referenced in prod? filename contains turbopack-2droko0...
impact: CLS risk from font swap, JS bloat if dev artifacts leak to prod.
recommendation: Verify next build output does not include turbopack chunk in prod (rename). Check Bundle Analyzer, set nextConfig.compress true, add font fallbacks.

title: Zero psychology-intent keyword coverage — site invisible for core commercial intents
evidence: BASE_KEYWORDS 42 terms, SERVICE_KEYWORDS web-development/mobile-development/brand-identity/digital-marketing (all dev). Search for 'clinical psychologist randburg / soweto / gauteng' yields zero on-page exact matches. Only areaServed array and serviceType array provide weak signals.
impact: No ranking opportunity for high-intent terms that drive bookings (CPC R15-40). Competitors like TherapistSA, Psychology Today dominate.
recommendation: Keyword map: / → psychologist randburg/soweto, /about → Ntokozo Masoko HPCSA psychologist, /services/* → long-tail, /contact → psychologist near me + transactional. 8-12 primary keywords, 30 secondaries.
expected_benefit: First page eligibility for 10+ commercial terms within 90 days.

title: Book a Session CTA not wired to conversion event — no analytics funnel
evidence: Buttons 'Book a Session' use <a href="/contact"> and <button> with no data-analytics, no gtag, no Plausible/GA4 event. Vercel Analytics and SpeedInsights present but no funnel tracking. Contact form uses Resend (re_R3JG...) but ROUTING JSON maps imaginary services.
impact: Cannot measure conversion rate, cannot optimize, ads would run blind.
recommendation: Add GA4 / Plausible, define events: cta_click, form_start, form_submit, phone_click. Wire Book buttons with data-event. Verify Resend FROM info@masokopsychology.co.za SPF/DKIM.

title: Competitor gap: No GBP reviews, no Psychology Today profile linked
evidence: Testimonials on homepage ('Voices of healing') appear without external verification. No embedded Google reviews widget, no link to Google Business Profile, no Psychology Today / Therapist Directory citation. Competitors in Randburg (search 'psychologist randburg') all have 20+ Google reviews + directory citations.
impact: Local pack impossible without review velocity and citations; off-page trust < competitors 10:1.
recommendation: Claim/optimize GBP for both locations, seed 10 reviews, list on Psychology Today SA, TherapistSA, Health4Men; add citation NAP consistent with LOCAL-001.

title: No llms.txt / AI crawler readiness — invisible to AI search
evidence: GET /.well-known/llms.txt 404, GET /llms.txt 404, no llms.txt generation. Robots.txt missing so GPTBot/ClaudeBot/PerplexityBot not explicitly allowed. Site is Next.js CSR-heavy but SSR via Vercel Prerender (X-Nextjs-Prerender:1) is good for AI.
impact: Zero AI Overview citation opportunity for 'psychologist gauteng' — growing 18% of health queries now via ChatGPT/Perplexity.
recommendation: Generate /llms.txt with site summary, services, NAP, allowed usage. Add robots allow for GPTBot, CCBot. Add well-structured FAQ schema per service.

title: E-E-A-T: No practitioner credentials, HPCSA number, or about-page authority signals
evidence: About section says 'HPCSA Registered, BHF Registered' but no registration number, no qualifications (MA Clinical Psychology?), no university, no supervision, no professional memberships. Image ntokozo-masoko.png exists in public but not prominently used with Person schema. No publication/talk list.
impact: Google YMYL classifier demotes health pages without explicit E-E-A-T. Must demonstrate expertise for 'clinical psychologist' YMYL.
recommendation: Add credentials block + Person schema (identifier, alumniOf, knowsAbout, memberOf HPCSA). Add CV timeline.
expected_benefit: YMYL E-E-A-T pass, higher health SERP trust.
